clip_key: # Tourists: they have never flown a ship. Dialogues with the crew, between two tourists, on the radio with
# Mission Control, and callouts for a ship with only tourists aboard. New keys: tu_
# trait tourist: a tourist speaks first (an intercom chat goes to a crew member who is not a tourist).
# trait to_tourist: a crew member talks to a tourist. trait tourist_pair: two tourists. Both only intercom.
# Columns and values: audio/lonapse/README.md. UTF-8, tab separated, # starts a comment line.

english: Does this shake a lot at liftoff? | Is liftoff bumpy?
A bit. Hold on and breathe.
Okay. Hold on to what?
Where's the bathroom? | Is there a bathroom?

spanish: Buena pregunta. Tenías que haber ido antes.
english: Good question. You should have gone before.
Does that red button do anything? | What does the red button do?

spanish: Sí. Por eso nadie lo toca.
english: Yes. That's why nobody touches it.
Just asking.
Who's driving right now?

spanish: Nadie. En órbita la nave va sola.
english: Nobody. In orbit the ship flies itself.
That doesn't calm me down at all.
Can I open the window for a second?
No. Never. Please.
How much longer? | Are we there yet?
A while. Look at the stars.
I've looked at all of them.
My stomach is floating.

spanish: Es normal. Mira un punto fijo.
english: That's normal. Look at a fixed point.

spanish: Aquí todo se mueve. No hay puntos fijos.
english: Everything moves up here. There are no fixed points.

spanish: ¿Me haces una foto con la ventana?
english: Can you take my photo by the window?
I'm working.

spanish: Solo una. Es para mi madre.
english: Just one. It's for my mother.
Fine. Smile.
Can I go out for a walk?

spanish: Los pasajeros se quedan dentro. Está en el contrato.
english: Passengers stay inside. It's in the contract.
Nobody reads contracts.
Do they sell souvenirs here?

spanish: Aquí no hay nadie. Ni tiendas.
english: There's nobody here. No shops either.
Why do you do so much math?
To get back home.
Then keep going, keep going.
What do I do if I get bored?

spanish: No tocar nada. Eso ya es mucho.
english: Don't touch anything. That's plenty.
Is this a real seatbelt?
Yes. Tighter.
Any tighter and I can't breathe.

spanish: Desde aquí no veo mi casa.
english: I can't see my house from here.

spanish: Estamos sobre el agua. Espera una vuelta.
english: We're over water. Wait one orbit.
Why is the window orange?

spanish: Es el calor de la entrada. Es normal.
english: That's reentry heat. It's normal.

spanish: Nadie me dijo que eso fuera normal.
english: Nobody told me that was normal.
Can't Control hear us anymore?

spanish: Durante un rato no. Luego vuelven.
english: Not for a while. They'll be back.

spanish: Pues luego diles que me porto bien.
english: Then tell them later that I behaved.
Do they pay you for this?
Not much. And you paid to come?
A fortune.
Can I press something? A small one.

spanish: Ese de ahí. No hace nada.
english: That one there. It does nothing.
How exciting!
It's really hot in here!
Hold on. It's almost over.

spanish: ¿Por qué damos vueltas? ¿Es parte del viaje?
english: Why are we spinning? Is this part of the trip?
No. But I'm fixing it.
I can't lift my arms.
Don't even try. It'll ease off.
What was that bang?
Nothing serious. Sit down.

spanish: Ya lo estoy. Más que nunca.
english: I am. More than ever.
Does this happen on every trip?
On the good ones, yes.
I want to get off. Where's the stop?
There are no stops. Breathe.
First time on a rocket?
First time out of the house.

spanish: Ese panel no se toca, por favor.
english: Please don't touch that panel.

spanish: No lo toco. Solo lo miro de cerca.
english: I'm not touching it. Just looking closely.
From farther away.

spanish: Mira por la ventana. ¿Qué te parece?
english: Look out the window. What do you think?
That it was worth the money.
Are you okay? You don't look well.

spanish: Floto y tengo mala cara. Todo nuevo para mí.
english: I'm floating and I look bad. All new to me.
There's a bag right there.
If you need anything, ask.
Are there any movies?
There's a window.

spanish: Cuando empiece a temblar, no grites.
english: When it starts shaking, don't scream.
And if I scream a little?
A little is fine.
Stop spinning the seat.

spanish: El asiento no gira. Giro yo.
english: The seat isn't spinning. I am.

spanish: Te doy la bienvenida a otro mundo.
english: Welcome to another world.

spanish: Huele igual que el de antes.
english: It smells just like the old one.
Strap in when you sleep.
So I don't fall?

spanish: Para no despertar flotando en la cocina.
english: So you don't wake up floating in the galley.

spanish: Tu comida está en el cajón azul.
english: Your food is in the blue drawer.

spanish: ¿Esto es comida? Pensaba que era pasta de dientes.
english: This is food? I thought it was toothpaste.

spanish: Respira despacio. El mareo se pasa.
english: Breathe slowly. The sickness passes.
When?
Roughly when we land.

spanish: No salgas. Lo digo en serio.
english: Don't go outside. I mean it.

spanish: Ni siquiera sé abrir la puerta.
english: I don't even know how to open the door.
Better that way.
What will you tell everyone when you get back?
That I was flying it.
Of course you were.

spanish: Ahora se calienta todo. Con calma.
english: Now everything heats up. Stay calm.
I'm calm. On the outside.

spanish: Las manos en las rodillas, por favor.
english: Hands on your knees, please.

spanish: ¿En las mías o en las tuyas?
english: Mine or yours?

spanish: Ese ruido es el ventilador. No pasa nada.
english: That noise is the fan. Nothing's wrong.

spanish: Llevo una hora con miedo a un ventilador.
english: I've been scared of a fan for an hour.

spanish: Esto es fuerte, pero está previsto.
english: This is rough, but it's planned.
Planned by whom?
By very smart people. I think.
We're spinning. Close your eyes.

spanish: Con los ojos cerrados giro más.
english: With my eyes closed I spin more.

spanish: Vas a notar mucho peso. Es normal.
english: You'll feel very heavy. That's normal.

spanish: Me siento como un saco de patatas.
english: I feel like a sack of potatoes.

spanish: ¿Estás bien? Eso ha sido un golpe.
english: Are you okay? That was a bump.

spanish: Me he mordido la lengua. Y el bocadillo.
english: I bit my tongue. And my sandwich.

spanish: Mírame a mí, no a la ventana.
english: Look at me, not at the window.
Your face doesn't calm me down either.
Let go of that lever. Slowly.
This one? Done. What did it do?
Better you don't know.
Did you buy the full package too?
No. The basic one. No window.

spanish: Te dejo mirar por la mía.
english: You can look through mine.

spanish: ¿Eso de ahí es una estrella o un botón?
english: Is that a star or a button?

spanish: Un botón. Las estrellas están fuera.
english: A button. The stars are outside.
Look, I'm floating upside down.

spanish: Aquí no hay abajo. Lo ha dicho la tripulación.
english: There's no down up here. The crew said so.
Then I'm floating right side up.

spanish: ¿Crees que nos dejarán conducir un poco?
english: Do you think they'll let us drive a bit?

spanish: Yo ya pregunté. Se rieron mucho.
english: I already asked. They laughed a lot.
I ate your dessert.
That was my dinner.
Well, it was delicious.
How many photos have you taken?

spanish: Cuatrocientas. Casi todas de la ventana.
english: Four hundred. Almost all of the window.

spanish: Yo tengo cuatrocientas tuyas mirando la ventana.
english: I have four hundred of you looking at the window.
Are we there?

spanish: Creo que sí. Ya no se mueve nada.
english: I think so. Nothing's moving anymore.

spanish: Qué pena. Ahora que me gustaba.
english: Shame. Just when I liked it.
There's nothing here.
That's why it's so expensive.

spanish: ¿Entiendes algo de lo que dicen por la radio?
english: Do you understand anything they say on the radio?

spanish: Solo la palabra recibido. La dicen mucho.
english: Just the word copy. They say it a lot.

spanish: Si me desmayo, despiértame para la foto.
english: If I faint, wake me up for the photo.

spanish: Si me desmayo yo, haz la foto igual.
english: If I faint, take the photo anyway.

spanish: El folleto decía que había vistas.
english: The brochure said there'd be a view.
There is a view.
It said a view with snacks.
Do you get sick?
Only when you look at me like that.
I'm going to write a review.
How many stars?

spanish: Todas las que veo. Son muchas.
english: All the ones I can see. That's a lot.

spanish: ¿Sabes qué hace la tripulación todo el día?
english: Do you know what the crew does all day?
Look at numbers and sigh.
Do you see everything orange too?
I see my whole life.
Will they let us stay one more night?

spanish: Pregunta tú. Yo ya pregunté lo de conducir.
english: You ask. I already asked about driving.
Is this heat normal?

spanish: La tripulación no grita. Será normal.
english: The crew isn't screaming. Must be normal.
We're spinning!
I know! So is my sandwich!
Even my ears feel heavy.

spanish: Las mías se han hundido en el asiento.
english: Mine sank into the seat.
What was that?

spanish: No lo sé. Yo no he tocado nada. Esta vez.
english: I don't know. I didn't touch anything. This time.
Hold my hand.

spanish: Ya te la doy. La que tiembla es la mía.
english: I am. The shaking one is mine.

spanish: Si salimos de esta, pido que me devuelvan el dinero.
english: If we get out of this, I want a refund.
I want double.

spanish: Control, ¿me oís? Llamo desde el asiento de atrás.
english: Control, can you hear me? Calling from the back seat.

spanish: Te oímos. No toques la radio, por favor.
english: We hear you. Please don't touch the radio.

spanish: Control, saludad a mi familia de mi parte.
english: Control, say hi to my family for me.
We'll make a note.
Control, does it always roar like this?
Always. Enjoy it.

spanish: Control, ¿a qué hora es la comida?
english: Control, what time is lunch?
When you get back.

spanish: Control, aquí no me dejan tocar nada.
english: Control, they won't let me touch anything up here.
Good. Very good.
Control, are we nearly there?
Almost. Hold on.
Control, can I still change my mind?
Not anymore. Sorry.

spanish: Control, ¿veis mi casa en el radar?
english: Control, can you see my house on radar?

spanish: Vemos vuestra nave. Tu casa no.
english: We see your ship. Not your house.

spanish: Control, ¿qué es ese ruido de fuera?
english: Control, what's that noise outside?
The air. It's normal.

spanish: ¿Qué tal el viaje en los asientos de atrás?
english: How's the trip in the back seats?
Five stars. Minus the food.

spanish: Os recordamos que los pasajeros no salen.
english: A reminder that passengers stay inside.

spanish: Ya lo sé. Me lo han dicho cuatro veces.
english: I know. I've been told four times.
Control, I'd like to file a complaint.
Go ahead.
There's no gravity up here.
Control, is it supposed to burn like this?
Yes. You're protected.
Control, the seat is crushing me.
Hold on. It passes soon.
Control, we're spinning. Do you know?
We know. We're on it.

spanish: Control, quiero volver a casa. Ya.
english: Control, I want to go home. Now.
We're on it. Breathe deep.
Did something fall off?
Oops! Was that supposed to come off?
Something went clunk. Is that good?
Parachutes! I think.

spanish: ¿Qué es esa tela de ahí fuera?
english: What's that cloth out there?
We're floating! Thank you, cloth!

spanish: Ya no caemos tan rápido. Me gusta.
english: We're not falling so fast. I like it.
Is that it? Are we there?
Ground! Real ground!
Water! Can anyone swim?

spanish: Flotamos. Como un barco muy caro.
english: We're floating. Like a very expensive boat.
